title: 检查累计两次提交
code: printf '%s %s %s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD~2)" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" refs/heads/main | "$WM_PROJECT_DIR/bin/tools/pre-receive-hook"
explanation: 扩大到两次提交的合并变化，适用于一次推送多个提交。

title: 从已记录基线检查
code:
baseCommit=$(git rev-parse HEAD~2)
targetCommit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
printf '%s %s %s\n' "$baseCommit" "$targetCommit" refs/heads/review | "$WM_PROJECT_DIR/bin/tools/pre-receive-hook"
explanation: 将提交 ID 保存为变量，可在审查记录中保留明确的起止点。

title: 批量检查两次更新
code: printf '%s %s %s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD~2)" "$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" refs/heads/reviewA "$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" refs/heads/reviewB | "$WM_PROJECT_DIR/bin/tools/pre-receive-hook"
explanation: 标准输入给出两行，模拟一次接收多个引用更新，脚本逐行检查。

title: 从保存的更新清单复查
code:
printf '%s %s %s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" refs/heads/main > receive-check.txt
"$WM_PROJECT_DIR/bin/tools/pre-receive-hook" < receive-check.txt
explanation: 保存的清单使之后的检查指向同一提交范围，输出问题文件及行号。
